section.title: Lang Class Reference
Detailed Description
section.para: This class contains constants used for localization and internationalization within the Bearsampp application. The constants are categorized into various sections such as General, Single, Menu, Bins, Apps, Tools, Errors, Actions, Windows forms, and Homepage. Each constant represents a key that can be used to retrieve localized strings from a language file or database.

section.title: getKeys()
section.para: Get all the keys defined in the Lang class.
This method returns an array of all the constants defined in the Lang class. These constants are used as keys for localization and internationalization purposes within the Bearsampp application.

formalpara.para: array An array of all the localization keys.
